[P2] Measure the quiet window using snapshot acquisition times

`worker_snapshot()` returns a snapshot captured before Lambda completion and result polling. This check counts that delivery latency toward the quiet window. For example, empty snapshots captured at t=0 and t=2 satisfy the five-second requirement if the second response arrives at t=6. Work starting at t=3 is absent from both snapshots, so settlement can authorize reuse while the worker is active. Require snapshot acquisition times—or conservative probe-start times—to span `quietSeconds`, and add a regression with delayed result delivery and intervening activity.
